pages.text: Steam machines (macerator, furnace, forge hammer, alloy smelter, compressor, extractor, rock crusher, miner) exist as Low and High Pressure versions. High Pressure uses the improved steel hull and is faster.
Chain: Coke Oven (coal to coke + creosote), Primitive Blast Furnace (iron + coke to steel), then craft the LV machine hull. Steel ends the steam age.
